Frontend UI testing confirms all 4 critical bugs are fixed: auth redirect, asymmetric marketplace, profile visibility, and session persistence. Found and fixed 1 additional bug during testing (brand profile Instagram verification not being set).

bug_fixes_verified.auth_redirect_bug: FIXED - Clicking brand/creator cards does NOT redirect to login when authenticated
bug_fixes_verified.asymmetric_marketplace: FIXED - Creators can now discover and unlock brands, brands can discover and unlock creators
bug_fixes_verified.profile_visibility: FIXED - New profiles appear in marketplace immediately after onboarding with Instagram verification
bug_fixes_verified.session_persistence: FIXED - Sessions persist via localStorage token, users stay logged in across navigation
